title: Bodytype boundary sensitivity v2 grid row
description: One row of the synthetic four-girth rule-space scan. The same schema applies to grid-sample.csv, the full grid.csv and grid.parquet. It is not a population record and contains no user measurements.

bust_cm.description: Bust circumference in centimetres, before any rounding.

waist_cm.description: Waist circumference in centimetres, before any rounding.

high_hips_cm.description: High hip circumference in centimetres, before any rounding.

base_label.description: Bodytype v2 label for the unshifted point.

stability_radius_cm.description: Smallest single-field shift that changes the label, in centimetres. 0 means the point sits on a boundary; Infinity means no other label is reachable within 60 cm. Stored as a string to preserve the exact notation.

neighbor_labels.description: Reachable labels in project order, separated by a vertical bar; empty when none are reachable.

proximity_tier.description: Display tier derived from the stability radius: very-close (<1 cm), close (<3 cm), hidden (>=3 cm).

nearest_threshold.description: Nearest threshold label, for example bustToHip:0.95. This is a grouping field, not necessarily the threshold crossed by a flip.

nearest_threshold_distance.description: Absolute ratio distance to the nearest threshold; used for grouping only.

flip_any_0_5cm.description: Whether any single-field ±0.5 cm shift changes the label.

flip_any_1cm.description: Whether any single-field ±1 cm shift changes the label.

flip_any_2cm.description: Whether any single-field ±2 cm shift changes the label.

flip_fields_1cm.description: Fields and directions that flip under ±1 cm, for example waist:+1; empty when no flip occurs.

flip_labels_1cm.description: Distinct labels reached under ±1 cm, separated by a vertical bar; empty when no flip occurs.

round_0_5_label.description: Label after rounding inputs to 0.5 cm.

round_1cm_label.description: Label after rounding inputs to 1 cm.

round_0_1in_label.description: Label after rounding inputs to 0.1 inch and converting back to centimetres.

unit_round_trip_label.description: Label after exact cm → in → cm conversion with no intermediate rounding.

unit_round_trip_changed.description: Whether the exact unit round trip changes the label.

skipped_out_of_range.description: Whether any perturbation was skipped because it fell outside 40–200 cm.
